author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hi Val,
Yes, the reason I asked for some more precise terms to be created is to avoid accumulating "adaptor" terms, otherwise in five years we will have the same problem we had with "binding" terms. We plan to review all the corresponding annotations to distinguish between real adaptors, and regulators, scaffolds, structural constituents, ... 
This will be done once the the scaffold term will be available for PAINTing.
Please, in order to avoid confusion and loading the same families multiple times, it would be best not to create any tickets about this topic.
Thank you.
Cheers,
Marc.
